name: Homemade Air Fryer Falafel Balls with Lemon-Tahini Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry parsley and cilantro. Shave parsley and cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and place leaves in the bowl of a food processor.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
½ small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and roughly chop onion. Add to the food processor with the herbs.
Peel and roughly chop garlic. Add to the food processor along with spices. Process, scraping down the sides as needed, until blended, about 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 clove garlic
1 tsp cumin, ground
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse chickpeas. Pat dry with paper towels and add to the food processor. Pulse 2-3 times, until just blended.
Sprinkle flour and baking powder over the chickpea mixture and pulse 2-3 times more. (The mixture should be well combined but not puréed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup all-purpose flour
1 tsp baking powder

instructions.primary_message: Transfer the chickpea mixture to a medium bowl. Cover and place in the fridge to chill for 2-3 hours.

To cook the falafel balls, remove chilled chickpea mixture from the fridge; using a rounded tablespoon measure, form the mixture into balls. Transfer to a plate. (You can use additional flour on your hands if the mixture is too sticky.)

Coat the bottom of the air fryer basket with cooking spray. Place sesame seeds in a small bowl. Working one at a time, add falafel balls to the bowl with the sesame seeds and turn to coat on all sides. Transfer falafel balls to the basket, spacing them apart. Lightly coat with more cooking spray. (Work in batches, if necessary, to accommodate the size of your air fryer basket.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 spritz nonstick cooking spray
⅓ cup sesame seeds

instructions.primary_message: Insert basket into air fryer and set temperature to 350°F. Cook, turning halfway, until falafel balls are golden, about 15 minutes. Remove from air fryer.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, zest, and juice lemon into a small bowl. Add tahini, yogurt, water, and salt, then whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ lemon
¼ cup tahini
¼ cup plain Greek yogurt
⅛ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Arrange falafel balls on a platter and serve with sauce on the side. Enjoy!
